source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. BMC Firmware Revision.

    【After Test】

    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- BMC information check: read the BMC information in the Server Mgmt page ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" mc info 2>&1 + ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" fru print 2>&1 | head -30.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return `ipmitool mc info` + FRU so the user confirms the BMC firmware/model info shown in the BIOS page matches.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; mc info is relevant, but the added truncated FRU output is outside the two requested fields and command output does not establish Server Mgmt page readability.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; correctly focuses on firmware/IPMI versions and endpoint identity, but leaves the core display requirement conditional despite the Server Mgmt page test set.
historical_reviews.round_02: No additional exact-code technical record found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Verify that the Server Mgmt page presents the BMC firmware revision and IPMI version in human-readable form and that both values match the approved platform specification.
original_method: Capture the two values on the BIOS Server Mgmt page, collect complete read-only ipmitool mc info from the confirmed BMC, map the two representations, and compare both with the owner-approved versions.
manual_activity: A human must observe that the named values are displayed and human-readable on the Server Mgmt page. The agent can collect and compare BMC command output but cannot substitute it for page presentation.
required_inputs: BIOS console operator and capture method
Confirmed BMC endpoint and protected credentials
safety_requirements: Use read-only page observation and mc info only; do not update firmware or alter BMC configuration.
Verify the endpoint belongs to the selected SUT and protect credentials from logs.
Preserve complete raw command output and unedited page captures.
Stop on identity mismatch, accidental write path or management instability.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete read-only mc info and BMC/board identity.
Extract only Firmware Revision and IPMI Version and compare them with the supplied SPEC and page capture.
Report readability/version discrepancies without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Supply/approve expected versions and formatting policy.
Capture the two fields on the Server Mgmt page.
Resolve representation differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: mc info is applicable corroboration; fru print and head -30 add unrelated/truncated evidence and are not needed for the two source fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain complete ipmitool mc info against the confirmed BMC with credential-safe handling; compare Firmware Revision and IPMI Version only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC Firmware Revision, IPMI version, no-script state and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record raw Server Mgmt labels and full mc info output, normalize only documented numeric/string formatting, and compare firmware revision and IPMI version independently against the approved SPEC.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC and ipmitool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner firmware recipe and platform Server Mgmt field definition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds endpoint verification and raw machine-readable corroboration without expanding the test to FRU inventory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware auxiliary revision fields may be formatted differently and require an approved mapping.

project_override_considerations: Project-approved version targets make the case ready and may vary by release. They do not alter the master requirement to check both fields and page readability.
expected_evidence: Target identity and approved version recipe
Timestamped Server Mgmt page capture showing both readable values
Complete raw ipmitool mc info output from the same BMC
Post-collection management health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Server Mgmt test-set context, two listed fields and readability criterion coherently indicate a display check. Missing expected versions and formatting rules are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The two target fields and acceptance dimensions are identifiable. Missing SPEC, console, credentials or mapping affects readiness, not permanent blockage.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps mc info but removes unrelated FRU/truncation and rejects command output as proof of UI readability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains endpoint/version safeguards and classifies the page observation as MANUAL ONLY rather than a setup dependency.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates tool output, page evidence, execution status and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Concentrates evidence on the two required fields and prevents an unrelated partial FRU dump from masquerading as complete BMC information acceptance.
independent_technical_reasoning: The case belongs to the Server Mgmt page and includes a human-readability criterion. Machine-readable mc info validates the backing values but not their visual presentation; therefore the core acceptance remains MANUAL ONLY.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat page entry or command collection automatically after a mismatch; preserve the evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
